OVManager wiki

Everything from the first install to the day a certificate expires. Started from the panel itself? Go straight to first login.

How the pieces fit

OVManager is two programs on two kinds of machine:

  • The panel — the website you log into. It keeps the user list, quotas, expiry dates, settings and the audit log, in one SQLite database. A web process serves requests; a supervised child process runs the periodic jobs (traffic accounting, limit enforcement, backups, pruning, alerts).
  • OVNode — a small agent on every VPN server. It owns OpenVPN, the certificates and the per-user files.

The panel always calls the node. Nodes never call the panel, so you can move or replace the panel at any time without touching the VPN servers. Each request carries the node's API key in a header, and the panel verifies the node's TLS certificate strictly.

Defaults worth knowing

What a fresh install uses unless you say otherwise.
WhatDefault
Panel port2095
Panel URL pathrandom secret prefix, e.g. /a1b2c3d4/
Install modenative (systemd unit + virtualenv on the host)
Admin useradmin
Owner credentialnone at install time — a one-time claim key instead
TLSself-signed certificate
Data directory/var/lib/ovmanager
Install directory/opt/ovmanager
Serviceovmanager.service
CLIovm, alias ovmanager
New-user defaults30 days, 100 GB, 1 device
Node service port2083
OpenVPN port1194
